infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: JARVIS listens for your voice commands after you say "Hey Silverfox".
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: JARVIS converts your speech to text so it can understand you.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: JARVIS uses Face ID to unlock your assistant securely.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: JARVIS looks up contacts only when you ask it to.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: JARVIS adds reminders and events when you ask.
